[Find the right product for you][40]

Benefiting from our vertical integration - ranging from membrane electrode assembly (MEA) bipolar

durability, reliability, and high power density with the lowest total cost of ownership.

## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

###### Promise

## Customer support, when and where you need it most

As much as we’re a technology company, we are, first and foremost, here for our customers. We work
hard to understand the challenges you face and anticipate your needs. From the design validation
phase to system integration and after-sales support, we’re your partner in success. *Here for Life™*

[Customer Support][51]

[Customer Support][Customer Support]

## Clean power for the future

*Here for Life™* is the central pillar of our purpose. It signifies our recognition that
zero-emission power is imperative and the global transition to clean and secure energy is underway.
We are ready to play a pivotal role as a trusted partner, supporting the critical decarbonization
and energy security efforts of our customers, governments, and local communities.

[Our Sustainability][52]

[Clean power for the future]

## Tailored Solutions for Different Market Needs

[Talk to a Fuel Cell Expert][44]

From 70kW-360kW net power, Ballard’s heavy-duty fuel cell modules offer flexible and reliable
solutions for your transportation and power generation needs.

Powered by Ballard’s unique proton-exchange membrane (PEM) fuel cell stacks, our modules are
designed to meet the mechanical, electrical, and environmental requirements of the most demanding
applications.

#### Buses

Fuel cell electric buses are the only zero-emission technology that can directly replace diesel bus
fleets, offering the same route flexibility, fast refueling, and uncompromised performance in
challenging climates and environments. Hydrogen, as a low-carbon fuel, provides a scalable and
efficient refueling solution for bus depots.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Buses][45]

[Fuel Cell Buses]

#### Trucks

Fuel cell electric trucks provide fleet operators with the familiar experience of diesel power while
delivering the benefits of electrification: zero tailpipe emissions, low noise and vibration, long
range, quick refueling, and no compromise on payload, ensuring maximum vehicle utilization.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Trucks][46]

[Fuel Cell Trucks]

#### Rail

Hydrogen-powered fuel cell trains offer a cost-effective, high-performance, zero-emission
alternative to diesel trains and costly track electrification, providing a pathway to
decarbonization of train fleets.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell Rail][47]

[Fuel Cell Rail]

#### Marine

As the marine sector faces stricter emission standards for vessels, Ballard’s hydrogen fuel cells
offer a highly scalable, flexible, and reliable power source, providing zero emissions and
long-range distributed power solutions with specific marine type approvals.

[Learn more about Marine Fuel Cells][48]

[Marine Fuel Cells]

#### Stationary Power Generation

In response to electric grid constraints, disruptions and permitting restrictions, PEM fuel cells
offer a sustainable, quiet solution for stationary power generation ranging from hundreds of
kilowatts to megawatts – where reliability, low maintenance, and ability to cycle rapidly are
needed.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Power Generation][49]

[Fuel Cell in Power Generation]

#### Off Road & Material Handling

Productivity is crucial for many off-road and material handling applications. Zero-emission, fuel
cell-powered equipment allows operators to achieve significant economic and environmental benefits,
enhancing both efficiency and sustainability. Fuel cells also provide a path to decarbonization of
super heavy-duty off-road vehicles.

[Learn more about Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling][50]

[Fuel Cell in Off Road & Material Handling]

###### Promise

## Customer support, when and where you need it most

As much as we’re a technology company, we are, first and foremost, here for our customers. We work
hard to understand the challenges you face and anticipate your needs. From the design validation
phase to system integration and after-sales support, we’re your partner in success. *Here for Life™*

[Customer Support][51]

[Customer Support][Customer Support]

## Clean power for the future

*Here for Life™* is the central pillar of our purpose. It signifies our recognition that
zero-emission power is imperative and the global transition to clean and secure energy is underway.
We are ready to play a pivotal role as a trusted partner, supporting the critical decarbonization
and energy security efforts of our customers, governments, and local communities.

[Our Sustainability][52]

[Clean power for the future]

## ALPHA 50, The plant that changes everything. Large Scale Project Execution Redefined.

Meet the world's first full-scope
50 MW Green Hydrogen plant.

Powered by our state-of-the-art TRIDENT stack platform, ALPHA 50 produces high-purity hydrogen at 30

### Hydrogen truck solutions for a cleaner future

Hyroad is a hydrogen infrastructure platform with a mission to decarbonize long-haul trucking, one
of the most significant carbon-emitting sectors globally.

We are accelerating the adoption of zero-emission trucks with our innovative hydrogen-powered fleet
solutions.

[Learn More ][7]

## We're building the backbone of a
## hydrogen ecosystem for trucks.

Our comprehensive trucking-as-a-service solution includes:

[1.png]

Cutting-edge vehicles

Hydrogen-powered class-8 trucks. Simple, transparent $/mile pricing model. 

[Untitled design (4).png]

Comprehensive fuel supply

Conveniently located fueling stations and state-of-the art infrastructure.

[3.png]

Maintenance support

We help keep you on the road: From fuel cells to brakes, we have you covered.

[Client Banners (2)_edited.jpg]

### All delivered through a simple pay-per-mile model.

We believe the solution must be bespoke to the use case. Our focus on trucking means we make

# Webinar

## Reducing Grid Strain and Supporting Operational Growth with Fuel Cells

Learn how hydrogen fuel cells can help facilities reduce grid strain, avoid costly upgrades, and
support growth.

[Watch On Demand][71]

# Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

[Learn More][72]
[Green hydrogen ecosystem]


## Plug's Louisiana Hydrogen Plant

Take a 3D tour of Plug's hydrogen plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana.

[View The Tour][73]
[Plug Louisiana hydrogen plant tour]


## Produce and Liquefy Hydrogen

Plug is proud to offer its customers industry-leading electrolyzer products and affordable hydrogen,
which is quickly becoming the molecule of choice for customers both large and small.

[Learn more][74]
[2 TPD electrolyzer]


## Transport Hydrogen

Plug offers trailer solutions to transport hydrogen from production plants to users around the world
daily.

[Learn more][75]
[Transport Hydrogen]


## Store and Handle Hydrogen

Plug offers fully integrated turnkey handling systems with capacities ranging from 60 kg to 8,000 kg
per day as liquid or gas.

[Learn more][76]
[Store and Handle Hydrogen]


## Use Hydrogen

Plug's hydrogen can power a spectrum of applications to help the world safely meet its environmental
goals.

[Learn more][77]
[Forklift fuel cell]

## Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is the only company delivering a complete hydrogen platform, from production and liquefaction
to storage, delivery, and power generation. These are not standalone technologies. They are
integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

[MHE forklifts]

Warehouses and distribution centers are seeking alternatives to lead-acid batteries.

**Hydrogen fuel cells are elevating the future of material handling.**

[Learn More][78]
[electrolyzer decarb]

Industrial applications are working to decarbonize their operations.

**Learn how Plug makes this possible.**

[Learn More][79]
[stationary power]

The need for zero emission backup, intermittent, or primary power sources is becoming more critical.

**Hydrogen is making it happen.**

[Learn More][80]

## Plug is Powering the Hydrogen Revolution

Plug is powering the hydrogen revolution. Many organizations want clean energy solutions to help
them solve tough productivity and operational challenges. Hydrogen can be used in many different
applications. Plug is leading the way. Plug’s customer demand for hydrogen has grown by 10 times in
five years — nearly a 200% annual growth rate. Our clean energy solutions are solving problems for a
wide range of customers worldwide.

# Webinar

## Reducing Grid Strain and Supporting Operational Growth with Fuel Cells

Learn how hydrogen fuel cells can help facilities reduce grid strain, avoid costly upgrades, and
support growth.

[Watch On Demand][71]

# Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

[Learn More][72]
[Green hydrogen ecosystem]


## Plug's Louisiana Hydrogen Plant

Take a 3D tour of Plug's hydrogen plant in St. Gabriel, Louisiana.

[View The Tour][73]
[Plug Louisiana hydrogen plant tour]


## Produce and Liquefy Hydrogen

Plug is proud to offer its customers industry-leading electrolyzer products and affordable hydrogen,
which is quickly becoming the molecule of choice for customers both large and small.

[Learn more][74]
[2 TPD electrolyzer]


## Transport Hydrogen

Plug offers trailer solutions to transport hydrogen from production plants to users around the world
daily.

[Learn more][75]
[Transport Hydrogen]


## Store and Handle Hydrogen

Plug offers fully integrated turnkey handling systems with capacities ranging from 60 kg to 8,000 kg
per day as liquid or gas.

[Learn more][76]
[Store and Handle Hydrogen]


## Use Hydrogen

Plug's hydrogen can power a spectrum of applications to help the world safely meet its environmental
goals.

[Learn more][77]
[Forklift fuel cell]

## Plug is building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is driving energy independence forward by building the global hydrogen ecosystem.

Plug is the only company delivering a complete hydrogen platform, from production and liquefaction
to storage, delivery, and power generation. These are not standalone technologies. They are
integrated, end-to-end solutions designed to make hydrogen work at industrial scale across regions,
industries, and applications.

[MHE forklifts]

Warehouses and distribution centers are seeking alternatives to lead-acid batteries.

**Hydrogen fuel cells are elevating the future of material handling.**

[Learn More][78]
[electrolyzer decarb]

Industrial applications are working to decarbonize their operations.

**Learn how Plug makes this possible.**

[Learn More][79]
[stationary power]

The need for zero emission backup, intermittent, or primary power sources is becoming more critical.

**Hydrogen is making it happen.**

[Learn More][80]

## Plug is Powering the Hydrogen Revolution

Plug is powering the hydrogen revolution. Many organizations want clean energy solutions to help
them solve tough productivity and operational challenges. Hydrogen can be used in many different
applications. Plug is leading the way. Plug’s customer demand for hydrogen has grown by 10 times in
five years — nearly a 200% annual growth rate. Our clean energy solutions are solving problems for a
wide range of customers worldwide.

## About us

### Wuhu Acteco powertrain Co., Ltd.

Founded in April 2019, Acteco is mainly engaged in the R&D,production and sales of powertraln
products such as engines, transmissions andelectric drives. Engine products Include gasoline,
diesel, hydrogen fuel and flexible fuel engines, with a displacement of 0.6L-2.0L and the power
covering 24kW-190kw. The transmission products include 8AT automatic transmissions, 1-speed and
3-speead series-paralle hybrid transmissions. The electric drive products include a varietyof 7-in-1
electric drive products. Powertrain products are widely used in the fields of automobile, aviation,
boat, off-road vehicle, generator set, etc. Acteco currently has more than 2,500 employees, owns
morethan 2,000 patents and its annual revenue is above 20 billion Yuan. Acteco has been awarded as
the “High-tech Enterprise”,Anhui Province Green Factory”, “Anhui Enterprise R&D Center”, and has won
theNational First Prize of Excellent Quality Management Group Activity Achievement inMachinery
Industry’ for four consecutive years. Acteco also won national awards such as “China Top Ten Engines
of the Year” and “China Top Ten New Energy Vehicle Popwer Systems.

Agricultural Trader is your trusted online hub for buying and selling agricultural machinery across
the UK, including tractors, mowers, combines, ATV vehicles and much much more.

Whether you’re after a dependable tractor, a durable trailer, or specialised farming tools,
Agricultural Trader platform connects you with a wide range of equipment to meet your needs.

Agricultural Trader is part of an established publishing house with a long history of serving the
agricultural community. Proudly associated with *Farm Machinery*, we combine decades of expertise
with a modern, easy-to-use platform, ensuring a reliable and convenient experience for farmers,
dealers, and machinery enthusiasts alike.

Our goal is simple: to make finding and selling farm machinery effortless. For buyers, we offer
detailed listings with descriptions, photos, and specs to help you make informed decisions to find
agricultural equipment for sale and used farm equipment for sale. For sellers, we provide a
straightforward way to showcase your equipment to the right audience, whether you're upgrading or
passing on machinery that’s served you well.

At Agricultural Trader, we’re more than just a marketplace—we’re part of a community that values the
hard work and dedication of the farming world.

## About Us

Agricultural Trader is your trusted online hub for buying and selling agricultural machinery across
the UK, including tractors, mowers, combines, ATV vehicles and much much more.

Whether you’re after a dependable tractor, a durable trailer, or specialised farming tools,
Agricultural Trader platform connects you with a wide range of equipment to meet your needs.

Agricultural Trader is part of an established publishing house with a long history of serving the
agricultural community. Proudly associated with *Farm Machinery*, we combine decades of expertise
with a modern, easy-to-use platform, ensuring a reliable and convenient experience for farmers,
dealers, and machinery enthusiasts alike.

Our goal is simple: to make finding and selling farm machinery effortless. For buyers, we offer
detailed listings with descriptions, photos, and specs to help you make informed decisions to find
agricultural equipment for sale and used farm equipment for sale. For sellers, we provide a
straightforward way to showcase your equipment to the right audience, whether you're upgrading or
passing on machinery that’s served you well.

At Agricultural Trader, we’re more than just a marketplace—we’re part of a community that values the
hard work and dedication of the farming world. 


Want to find out more? Contact our dedicated team [here][62].
